# The Syrophoenician Mother (Matthew 15:28)

## Emotional Focus
Praying for someone you love very much.

## Key KJV
“O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt.” (Matthew 15:28)

## Gentle Retelling
A mother begged Jesus to help her sick daughter. She kept asking with love. Jesus saw her faith and healed her little girl.

## Coloring Prompt
A mother kneeling before Jesus with hope while her daughter is shown healed in the background.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus hears when we pray for the people we love.”
